_doc: Skills the Skill tool exposes without a SKILL.md on disk. Static list written by hand; it may drift from what a given Claude Code build or account offers. Disable with {"builtins": false} in config.json. Entries are skipped when a skill of the same name exists on disk.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review the current diff, a PR, branch or path for correctness bugs, with optional fixes or PR comments. Use for code review, review this diff, review the PR before merge.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Security review of pending changes on the current branch: vulnerabilities, injection, auth flaws, secrets. Use for security review, security audit of a diff.

skills.name: simplify
skills.description: Review changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency and cleanup, then apply the fixes. Quality only, not bug hunting. Use to simplify, clean up or tidy recent changes.

skills.name: run
skills.description: Launch and drive the project's app to see a change working: run, start, screenshot the app, confirm a change in the real app rather than only tests.

skills.name: loop
skills.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval, e.g. check the deploy every 5 minutes, poll for status, keep running a command repeatedly.

skills.name: schedule
skills.description: Create, update, list or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) on a cron schedule, or a one-time scheduled run at a given time.

skills.name: update-config
skills.description: Configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json: hooks for automated behaviors, permissions, allow commands, env vars, settings.local.json changes.

skills.name: keybindings-help
skills.description: Customize Claude Code keyboard shortcuts: rebind keys, chord bindings, edit keybindings.json.

skills.name: fewer-permission-prompts
skills.description: Scan transcripts for common read-only tool calls and add an allowlist to project settings to reduce permission prompts.

skills.name: init
skills.description: Initialize a CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation for a repository.

skills.name: claude-api
skills.description: Reference for the Claude API and Anthropic SDK: model ids, pricing, streaming, tool use, prompt caching, token counting, MCP, agents, model migration. Use when code calls Claude or Anthropic models.

skills.name: dataviz
skills.description: Design guidance for any chart, graph, plot, dashboard or data visualization in any medium: chart colors, palettes, stat tiles, sparklines, heatmaps, legends, axes. Triggers on: chart, graph, plot, data viz, visualization, dashboard, sparkline, heatmap.

skills.name: anthropic-skills:pdf
skills.description: Work with PDF files: read or extract text and tables, merge, split, rotate, watermark, create PDFs, fill PDF forms, encrypt, OCR scanned PDFs.

skills.name: anthropic-skills:docx
skills.description: Create, read and edit Word documents (.docx): reports, letters, memos, meeting minutes, contracts, with formatting, tables, tracked changes and comments.

skills.name: anthropic-skills:xlsx
skills.description: Create, read and edit Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv): formulas, formatting, charts, financial models, budgets, data cleanup.

skills.name: anthropic-skills:pptx
skills.description: Create, read and edit PowerPoint presentations (.pptx): slide decks, pitch decks, board decks, layouts, speaker notes, templates.

skills.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
skills.description: Multi-source research with a synthesized narrative report: compare options, analyze markets, trends, literature reviews, competitive analysis.

skills.name: anthropic-skills:skill-creator
skills.description: Create, edit, evaluate and improve agent skills (SKILL.md), measure skill performance, optimize skill descriptions for triggering.
